Administration
Assessor
The Assessor's Office is responsible for estimating the market values of every parcel of legally described real estate in Wadena County. It is also responsible for classification of each parcel of property in Wadena County.
Attorney
The County Attorney prosecutes civil and criminal cases on behalf of the citizens of Wadena County.
Auditor/Treasurer
The Wadena County Auditor / Treasurer is a combined office which performs services tax, property, and more.
Community Corrections
Peruse corrections programs in the area.
County Commissioners
The Board of Commissioners have the responsibility of overseeing the management of the County's finances and resources.
County Extension
Court Administration
The Court Administrator's Office is responsible for actions of district court.
Elections and Voter Registration
View election documents.
Emergency Management
The role of Emergency Management is to maximize the protection and promotion of public safety, health and welfare during large scale emergencies.
Employment
Employment

Friendly Rider
Volunteers, drivers, and other members of Friendly Rider Transit will provide safe, reliable, courteous, and cost-effective transportation to our passengers.
Highway
The Wadena County Highway Department is responsible for the construction and maintenance of approximately 481 miles of county state aid highways and county roads as well as approximately 84 bridges and large culverts.

GIS

Planning & Zoning
The Wadena County Planning and Zoning Department is responsible to administer and enforce the County Zoning Ordinance Number 1 and the Subdivision Ordinance Number 4.
Recorder
The Recorders Office is responsible for all the real estate records for properties located in Wadena County. Another important function of the Recorders Office is to protect and issue certified copies of Birth and Death Records.
